components.name: ProductAnswer
components.summary: Presents the products a lookup found in the Pilar da Terra (VR Master) registration with how each criterion was understood.

props.name: answer
props.meaning: Generated SDK agent result: each criterion with the records or classification paths it resolved to, exclusions and the business rule of its relationship; counts per section, notes, the exact total and up to 200 products.

components.accessibility: A group named by its level-2 source heading; criteria in a description list; a native captioned table with scoped headers that states when only the first products are listed.
components.usage: Render only validated API results. Always show the interpretation beside the list: classification paths, exclusions and relationship rules are how a person checks what was selected.

examples.label: Category with an exclusion
examples.description: Synthetic classification paths and products; the preview makes no API, provider or ERP request.

components.name: ProductOptions
components.summary: Presents the numbered choices of a product clarification, such as two interpretations of a word or several matching buyers.

props.name: options
props.meaning: Generated SDK agent result with the dimension, the asked words and numbered option labels.

props.name: onChoose
props.meaning: Sends the chosen number as the next message; absent for earlier turns, which show the options as text.

components.accessibility: A group named by its title; each choice is a native button whose text includes its number, so typing the number is equivalent.
components.usage: Option labels can be personal data such as buyer names: they appear only in this result, never in the reply text that later turns send to the model.

examples.label: Two interpretations
examples.description: Synthetic choices; selecting one shows a local message and makes no request.
